The reported source file `crx_headers/bg_header.js` does not exist in the unpacked extension (confirmed by `list_files` and the harness warning). The real source is in `background.js`:

```js
chrome.storage.local.get(['email'], function (result) {

});
```

```js
chrome.storage.local.set({ 'email': message.data.email }, ...)
```

and it is used as a bearer token in backend requests (`headers: { 'authorization': email }`, lines 142/157). So the source is genuinely **SENSITIVE_DATA** — a stored credential — not a benign constant.
